purpose: Starting recommendations shown on the Model Session Policy card before the user has saved a profile. They are not applied automatically: until the user answers, every role inherits the session model.
basis: execution-allocation.md tier rule (mechanical work lowest fitting tier, prose implementers and reviewers at least mid tier, design judgment and final whole-change review highest tier) and model-policy.md evidence notes (Codex: GPT-6 Luna/medium as the cost-first start, Sol for complex judgment, Astra only by user choice).

claude.optionsSource: exact model ids from the claude-api reference (cached 2026-09-25) and the user-reported Claude Code model picker (2026-09-30); per-role model and effort are delivered by plugin role file frontmatter (verified by a live probe on Claude Code 2.1.284)

catalog.reason: Claude Code exposes no model-listing command; confirm against the model picker and record a mismatch as a user-reported correction

claude.deliveryNote: The Agent tool model argument takes only a family alias, and an alias runs the latest model of that family (Claude Code 2.1.284 --model help). A model without an entry here cannot be delivered per role; re-check this map when a new model is released.

scout.why: bounded read-only collection; user-chosen cost-down below the mid tier floor; Haiku takes no effort

implementer.why: plan-driven implementation; medium is the reference starting point for agentic coding

task-reviewer.why: task-scoped review; raise the model for security or payment scope

final-reviewer.why: whole-change judgment; claude-fable-5-1 only by user choice

task-reviewer.why: task-scoped review; raise effort for security or payment scope

final-reviewer.why: whole-change judgment; Sol is the step up from Luna
